author: ai
text: ASEAN had five founding members in 1967: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand. Brunei joined in 1984. Vietnam joined in 1995, Laos and Myanmar in 1997, and Cambodia in 1999. Timor-Leste joined in 2025. The membership table, checked on 21 October 2026, lists 11 members. The facts give no departures or suspensions.
